notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{B}{G}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {2}{B} due to Blood Funnel.
Blood Funnel triggers, causing you to sacrifice Selvala.
Resolve Corpse Dance, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield, giving it haste, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control another creature with power 5 or greater, this combo nets infinite colored mana.
